required
200
Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform successfully retrieved the list of domains for the specified child
account.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
Array of objects (Response-Accounts-Domains-Object)
An array of domain objects.
— 404 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform could not find the specified child account.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
